name: core.openwop.workflows.knowledge-sync
description: The workflow a knowledge-sync source (ADR 0107 / ADR 0605) fires on cadence (WF-KB-3 / KSWF-1). A single node runs one pass — list → diff → fetch+ingest → prune — over the configured Drive/OneDrive folder into the source's bound KB collection, with all the ADR 0605 hardening (pre-run lease, destructive-diff refusal, Tier-2 erasure, subject-scoped prune) behind the WF-KB-4 spend gate. `sourceId` identifies which SyncSource to sync; the per-source scheduler job registered at source creation supplies it automatically — do not bind this chain by hand. This lane replaces the retired knowledgeSyncDaemon, folding the recurring sync onto the ONE host scheduler. Resolves on hosts that ship the knowledge-sync feature + node pack (the OpenWOP reference app).
author: openwop

chains.label: Knowledge Sync
chains.description: Run one scheduled sync pass for a knowledge-sync source — list → diff → fetch+ingest → prune — into its bound KB collection. `sourceId` is the SyncSource this run syncs; supplied by the per-source scheduler job (or "sync now") registered at source creation — never set this by hand.

sourceId.description: The knowledge-sync SyncSource this run syncs. Supplied by the per-source scheduler job (or "sync now") registered at source creation — never set this by hand.

status.description: `success` on a completed pass, or `skipped` (feature disabled / not entitled / backoff / in flight).

pruned.description: Documents pruned (gone from the folder) in this pass.
